title: Payment Returned on a Doubly Paid TRICARE Prime Installment
content:
On a TRICARE Prime installment other than the first installment that has been paid more than once, the payment the duplicate refund returns depends on how many payments stand against the refunded installment and on the method of the latest of them.

| More than one payment stands against the installment | Latest payment was made through | Duplicate refund returns |
|---|---|---|
| yes | a method other than the enrollment's payment arrangement | that latest payment |
| yes | the arrangement's own method | the earlier payments together |
| otherwise | - | the smaller of the latest payment and the earlier payments together |

## Cases (hypothetical, arrangement: electronic funds transfer)

- Against one monthly installment: 40.39 by transfer, then 40.39 by check. The latest came by check, a method other than the arrangement: the 40.39 check payment is returned.
- Against one monthly installment: 40.39 by check, then 40.39 by transfer. The latest came through the arrangement's own method: the earlier payments together, 40.39, are returned.
- A single payment stands against the installment: the earlier payments together come to 0.00, so the smaller of the two is 0.00.
